revisionDesc.change: Commit - Moved one of the suggestions for lin38 to the apparatus. Added suggestion for lin8.

Vote - AcceptText - I agree with Claytor about the beginning of the line: καιρός seems to fit the space better. I'm not sure whether the two lambdas in ἄλλος is enough for the lacuna, especially if παραγεινόμενος in the line below is correctly restored. On the other hand, perhaps παραγεινόμενος is too long. In short, I wonder if we're not better off taking up Andorlini's proposal in the apparatus as an alternative reading.

Vote - AcceptText - και̣[ρὸ]ς ἄρτι ἄ[λλ]ός ἐστιν is a better supplement than ed. pr. for reasons of space (the left strip may be a bit too close to fragments to the right, but it's roughly in the right place). Andorlini then prints καὶ ἄν, but κἂν is certain (this is rightly not submitted here as correction). What follows cannot be confirmed or denied (based on the image at least). The reading would have to be supported by parallels or a philological argument, but these aren't presented. I would accept και̣[ρὸ]ς ἄρτι ἄ[λλ]ός (better submitted as a single correction), but not the others.
Submit - Added improved reading by I. Andorlini at l. 38
